prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE standalone square transparent mineral-overlay master for a Minecraft Java 16x16 ore block.
Primary request: Copper Bloom RICHER independent variant 2: A stepped fracture zone with two short physically related sulfide-filled segments at different angles, partly separated by host gap, plus one tiny dull oxidation junction. No network across face. Geological identity: fracture-controlled brassy copper sulfide with local dull oxidation. This is an incidental partial window into the deposit, not a complete diagram on one block. Its dip, thickness pattern, interruption and structure must differ materially from retained variant 0 and sibling variant 1; never a rotation, mirror, recolor or relocated stamp.
Scene/backdrop: genuine RGBA transparency, alpha zero everywhere outside physical mineral cells; no host stone, deepslate, matte, checkerboard, panel or shadow.
Style/medium: coarse logical 16x16 pixel art authored at high resolution, with hard-edged square pixel clusters about one-sixteenth of the canvas width. Flat mostly opaque medium values; no subpixel marks, hairlines, antialiasing or smooth miniature painting.
Composition/framing: RESTRAINED RICHER: about 25–48 visible logical cells, one modest local main exposure and at most one sparse associated structure. Broad transparent host gaps; clearly less than original full-strength suite. Shape coherence and role hierarchy matter more than exact numeric fill. Keep most of the square transparent. The whole family identity emerges across varied tiled blocks; this single block shows only the local section described.
Materials/textures: muted gray-olive sulfide #797c69 and #8a876e with very occasional attached dull oxidation; no saturated yellow or green. Use two or three close mineral values grouped inside structures, enough to read at native16 against mid-gray host. No dark outline, pale highlight rail, extreme pigment, halo, carved or raised relief, or blanket alpha fade.
Constraints: exactly one 1:1 square PNG at least 1024x1024, untouched mineral-only source with true transparent alpha, one standalone texture, no text, label, watermark or frame.
Avoid: green confetti, white quartz frame, central X, continuous colored stockwork; decorative speckles, centered object, complete whole-face seam or network, glow, gradients, haze, vignette, realism.
